## What's new in 1.2.1

**Random plays the same module on every monitor.** With two or more monitors, Random (or a list of modules to rotate through) now shows one module on all of them, and they change together. Before, each monitor picked its own. To get that back, tick **A different module on each monitor** in the settings window (under "Change module every"). Each monitor then picks at random, so two monitors can still show the same module now and then.

**On Linux**, under XScreenSaver (which runs one player per monitor), the players show the same module and change it at the same moment. The new `--different-modules` option, a checkbox in XScreenSaver's settings, gives each monitor its own.
